name: spicy-ship
description: Unattended story shipping: ship-it orchestrator, phase agents (explore, plan, review, execute, fix), shared review-loop and question-policy contracts, deterministic config resolution and review gating.

maxReviewRounds.title: Max review rounds
maxReviewRounds.description: Reviewer and fixer rounds per gate before the loop reports EXHAUSTED.

minReviewSeverity.title: Minimum severity that triggers another round
minReviewSeverity.description: Findings below this severity are fixed opportunistically but never cause a re-review.

questionMode.title: Open-question mode
questionMode.description: auto decides and logs; raise asks immediately; batch asks at checkpoints.
